description: Four chords of four notes each, set by knob in any temperament from 1 to 34 notes per octave, one chord at a time sent out on a polyphonic cable

params.text: Sets that note of that chord within the octave, from 0 up to one less than the notes-per-octave setting
Sets the octave of that note of that chord, -4 to +4
Sets the temperament, 1 to 34 notes in the octave, starting at 12

inputs.text: Chooses the chord that reaches the output: 0V for A, 1V for B, 2V for C, 3V for D, with a blue lamp on the chord in use; with nothing patched, chord A is sent

outputs.text: Carries the four notes of the chosen chord as four channels, at a volt per octave
